nodes.description: Mapping of holder balances; written by constructor, _transfer and read by balanceOf.
Nested allowance mapping; written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
Fixed total supply 1000*10**12*10**18 assigned at construction.
Token name string returned by name().
Token symbol string returned by symbol().
Token decimals set to 18 and returned by decimals().
Ownable owner slot; set in constructor, reset in renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Extra owner-like address initialized once to _msgSender() and used by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner (access-control backdoor).
SHAZAM constructor: mints _tTotal to the deployer and emits Transfer.
Returns the token name.
Returns the token symbol.
Returns the token decimals.
Private approval helper; zeroes allowance when the owner is not the contract owner, otherwise stores the full amount.
Returns the allowance for an owner/spender pair.
Public approve entry point delegating to _approve with msg.sender as owner.
Transfers on behalf of sender then decrements and re-approves sender's allowance to msg.sender.
Returns _tTotal.
Returns the balance of an account.
Public transfer entry point delegating to _transfer.
Internal balance-moving routine using SafeMath sub/add and emitting Transfer.
Returns the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner function that clears _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
onlyOwner function that sets a new owner after a zero-address check.
Context view returning msg.sender.
Address library helper using extcodehash inline assembly to detect contracts.
Address library helper performing a raw value transfer via recipient.call{value:amount}("").
Address library helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value on a target.
External caller identity used for minting, approvals, transfers and the newComer ownership check.
Low-level recipient.call{value:amount}("") inside sendValue; unchecked external interaction.
Low-level target.call{value:weiValue}(data) inside _functionCallWithValue using caller-supplied target and calldata.
Spender address argument of approve().
Amount argument of approve().
Sender address argument of transferFrom().
Recipient address argument of transferFrom().
Amount argument of transferFrom().
Account address argument of balanceOf().
Recipient address argument of transfer().
Amount argument of transfer().
Sender address parameter of _transfer().
Recipient address parameter of _transfer().
Amount parameter of _transfer().
Owner address argument of allowance(); shadows the owner() function name.
Spender address argument of allowance().
Owner address parameter ol of _approve().
Spender address parameter tt of _approve().
Amount parameter of _approve().
New owner address argument of transferOwnership().
Payable recipient parameter of Address.sendValue().
Value parameter of Address.sendValue().
Call target address parameter of _functionCallWithValue().
Calldata parameter of _functionCallWithValue().
Native value parameter of _functionCallWithValue().
Local address msgSender caching _msgSender() in the constructor.
Local bytes32 codehash resulting from extcodehash(account) in isContract().
Constant hash of an empty account used to compare against codehash in isContract().

edges.reason: spender argument flows into approve().
amount argument flows into approve().
spender is forwarded from approve() into _approve() and stored in _allowances.
amount is forwarded from approve() into _approve() and stored in _allowances.
sender argument flows into transferFrom().
recipient argument flows into transferFrom().
amount argument flows into transferFrom().
sender is forwarded from transferFrom() into _transfer().
recipient is forwarded from transferFrom() into _transfer().
amount is forwarded from transferFrom() into _transfer().
account argument indexes _balances in balanceOf().
recipient argument flows into transfer().
amount argument flows into transfer().
recipient is forwarded from transfer() into _transfer().
amount is forwarded from transfer() into _transfer().
sender key indexes _balances inside _transfer().
recipient key indexes _balances inside _transfer().
amount is subtracted/added on balances inside _transfer() via SafeMath.
owner argument indexes the _allowances mapping in allowance().
spender argument indexes the _allowances mapping in allowance().
ol parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in _approve().
tt parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in _approve().
amount parameter is written into _allowances in _approve().
newOwner parameter is written into _owner in transferOwnership().
recipient parameter is the destination of the low-level value transfer.
amount parameter is the value sent by the low-level call.
target parameter is the address of the arbitrary low-level call.
data parameter is the calldata of the arbitrary low-level call.
weiValue parameter is attached to the low-level call.
msg.sender receives the initial supply in the constructor.
_msgSender() is cached into the constructor local msgSender.
constructor local sets the Ownable _owner from msg.sender.
constructor writes _tTotal into _balances[msg.sender].
newComer state variable is initialized from the deployer msg.sender and later used by onlyOwner.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument of _approve inside approve().
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the sender of transfer().
_msgSender() returns msg.sender.
Caller-controlled value/recipient context reaches the raw value call.
Caller-controlled arguments can reach the arbitrary low-level call.
approve() invokes _approve() with a privileged branch for the contract owner.
transferFrom() calls _transfer() before updating allowance.
transferFrom() calls _approve() to rewrite sender allowance to msg.sender.
transfer() calls _transfer().
constructor mints by writing _balances.
constructor reads _tTotal for the mint amount.
_transfer mutates _balances with SafeMath sub/add.
balanceOf() reads _balances.
_approve writes _allowances, zeroing it when the owner is not the contract owner.
allowance() reads _allowances.
transferFrom() reads and updates _allowances.
_approve compares the owner argument against owner()/_owner before storing the amount.
name() returns _name.
symbol() returns _symbol.
decimals() returns _decimals.
totalSupply() returns _tTotal.
owner() returns _owner.
renounceOwnership() overwrites _owner with address(0).
transferOwnership() overwrites _owner with newOwner.
renounceOwnership() is gated by onlyOwner, which checks newComer instead of _owner.
transferOwnership() is gated by onlyOwner, which checks newComer instead of _owner.
onlyOwner compares newComer against _msgSender(), making the deployer-fixed address the real authority.
_functionCallWithValue() requires isContract(target) before calling.
sendValue() performs the unchecked low-level value transfer after only a balance check.
_functionCallWithValue() performs the unchecked low-level call with value.
extcodehash result is stored in the local codehash.
codehash is compared against accountHash and zero to determine contract-ness.
The recipient of the raw value call can re-enter sendValue state handling before completion.
The arbitrary call target can re-enter _functionCallWithValue or the calling contract.

normalization_plan.reason: spender is only meaningful as the approve() argument forwarded to _approve().
amount is only meaningful as the approve() argument forwarded to _approve().
sender is consumed only by transferFrom().
recipient is consumed only by transferFrom().
amount is consumed only by transferFrom().
account is the sole index used by balanceOf().
recipient is only used as the transfer() destination.
amount is only used as the transfer() value.
sender is the debited key inside _transfer().
recipient is the credited key inside _transfer().
amount is the value moved inside _transfer().
owner indexes the allowance lookup and exists only for allowance().
spender indexes the allowance lookup and exists only for allowance().
ol is the owner-side key of the _approve() write.
tt is the spender-side key of the _approve() write.
amount is the stored allowance value in _approve().
newOwner is only used to overwrite _owner in transferOwnership().
recipient is the destination of the raw value call.
amount is the value attached to the raw value call.
target is the callee of the arbitrary low-level call.
data is the calldata of the arbitrary low-level call.
weiValue is the value attached to the arbitrary low-level call.
msgSender is a temporary alias of _msgSender() used only during construction.
codehash is the transient extcodehash result inside isContract().
accountHash is the constant empty-account hash used only by isContract().
